newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan o/n rates edge lower in 3.00-3.50 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan o/n rates edge lower in 3.00-3.50 pct range.

text.p: Jordan overnight dinar rates edged slightly lower to 3.00-3.50 percent, from 3.00-4.00 percent on Sunday, as the market remained awash with excess dinars, dealers said.

Bankers attributed the easier liquidity to the start of monthly salary transfers by ministries and public institutions into the banking system along with weaker subsription to last week's 15 million dinar certificate of deposit (CD) auction.
